title: Sen. Ron Johnson Enters the Fight Club Ring August 31: Fighting Fauci and Government Corruption
text:
He’s one of the the few Senate conservatives battling to advance President Donald Trump’s agenda and take the fight to radical leftists, and now Sen. Ron Johnson (R-WI) will step into the ring of the Breitbart Fight Club for an exclusive members-only interactive roundtable event hosted by Breitbart Editor-in-Chief Alex Marlow and Washington Bureau Chief Matthew Boyle.

This is an opportunity for Fight Club Founding Members to hear from and interact with Sen. Johnson, covering a wide range of topics, including investigations into Anthony Fauci, Democrat corruption, and the MAHA movement.

In this Roundtable session, we’ll also ask Sen. Johnson…

✅  What the Senate is doing to expose Fauci’s corruption and hold him accountable

✅  How Republicans are addressing the growing Democrat radicalization throughout the nation

✅  How to keep the MAGA coalition together through the midterms and beyond

Join us for this online event with live audience Q&A…

Sen. Johnson has made his way into the hearts of Breitbart readers by simply doing what Americans elected him to do. He’s led investigations of corruption, championed taxpayers by rooting out spending that doesn’t benefit them, and led the push for MAHA before it was cool, advocating for true science on everything from vaccines to food pyramids.

He even created the immigration chart that saved President Trump’s life in Butler, Pennsylvania.

Previous heavyweights to step into the Fight Club Roundtable ring include Rep. Jim Jordan (R-OH), Sen. Marsha Blackburn (R-TN), White House Senior Counselor for Trade and Manufacturing Peter Navarro, Ambassador Mike Huckabee, EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin, Rep. James Comer (R-KY), and Deputy Assistant to the President and Senior Director for Counterterrorism Sebastian Gorka.

This online event is for eligible Breitbart Fight Club members only, and you can become one by joining now. Select “Middleweight” membership, billed annually, and we will email you a registration pass.

Only the Breitbart Fight Club gives members a chance to hang out together AND brings our nation’s leaders to YOU, so that you can connect with them in a live, interactive forum.
